## Cleaning mutations to keep variables of interest

Selecting variables of interest

```{r}
mutations_clean <- mutations |> 
                      select(c("Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
                               "Hugo_Symbol", 
                               "Chromosome", 
                               "Start_Position", 
                               "End_Position", 
                               "Strand", 
                               "Consequence",
                               "Variant_Type",
                               "Mutation_Status"))
```

Splitting the Tumor_Sample_Barcode into a Patient_id matching the one in the other 2 tables and a Tumor_Barcode

```{r}
mutations_clean <- mutations_clean |> 
                      mutate(Patient_id = str_sub(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 
                                                  start = 1, 
                                                  end = 9)) |> 
                      mutate(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = str_sub(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 
                                                            start = 11)) |> 
                      rename(Tumor_Barcode = Tumor_Sample_Barcode) |> 
                      relocate(Patient_id)
```

## Cleaning patients data set

Renaming Patient_id to match mutations column and modifying the way status is logged in the table.

```{r}
patients_clean <- patients |> 
                      rename(Patient_id = PATIENT_ID) |> 
                      mutate(Status = str_sub(OS_STATUS, 
                                      start = 3),
                             .keep = "unused")
```

### Extracting a list of patient ID from the mutations data set to subset samples and patients

```{r}
tumor_patient <- mutations_clean |> 
                    group_by(Patient_id) |> 
                    count() |> 
                    rename(Number_mutations = n)
```

Extracting rows corresponding to patients present in the mutations table and adding to patients_clean a column with number of mutations.

```{r}
patients_clean <- patients_clean |> 
                      inner_join(tumor_patient, join_by("Patient_id"))
```

## Cleaning the samples data set

Selecting variables of interest

```{r}
samples_clean <- samples |> 
                    select(c("PATIENT_ID", 
                             "SAMPLE_ID",
                             "CANCER_TYPE",
                             "SAMPLE_TYPE",
                             "METASTATIC_SITE",
                             "PRIMARY_SITE",
                             "CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED",
                             "SOMATIC_STATUS")) |> 
                    rename(Patient_id = PATIENT_ID) |>                       
                    mutate(Sample_Barcode = str_sub(SAMPLE_ID, 
                                      start = 11),
                             .keep = "unused")
                    
```

Extracting rows corresponding to patients present in the mutations table.

```{r}
samples_clean <- samples_clean |>
                    semi_join(tumor_id, by = "Patient_id")
```
